title: HB83 (2026 General): Imitation Firearm Amendments

operative_text: Section (new Utah Code 53-5a-109): "Minor" means an individual younger than 18 years old. It is an infraction for a minor to draw or exhibit an altered toy or imitation firearm if the minor: (a) intentionally or knowingly draws or exhibits the altered toy or imitation firearm in an angry and threatening manner in a public place; (b) knows the drawn or exhibited toy or imitation firearm is an altered toy or imitation firearm; and (c) has previously received a documented warning from a law enforcement officer warning the minor that it is unlawful for the minor to draw or exhibit an altered toy or imitation firearm in an angry and threatening manner in a public place.
